summary: Comprehensive testing of P2 features: Configurable News Retention Window and Dashboard Stats Caching. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend Settings page UI fully functional with retention dropdown, save button, and Pipeline Status card.
passed_tests: PUT /api/settings/retention with {retention_days: 14} - updates setting and returns confirmation
GET /api/dashboard/stats - includes retention_days field in response
Dashboard stats with 30d retention shows more items than 7d retention
Dashboard stats cache serves same data within 60s TTL
GET /api/intelligence with explicit date_from overrides retention filter
Retention boundary values (1 and 365 days) are valid
Settings page renders with 'Platform Settings' title
Settings page has retention dropdown with 7/14/30/60/90/180/365 day options
Settings page Save button works and shows success toast
Settings page Pipeline Status card shows total items, processing rate, sources, scheduler
Settings nav item visible in sidebar
Navigation from sidebar to Settings page works correctly

Cache invalidation is properly called on retention change
Retention filter correctly applied to both dashboard stats and intelligence feed
Explicit date_from parameter correctly overrides retention filter for advanced queries
Frontend Settings page has good UX with current setting display and success toast

seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (532 intelligence items, 472 within 30-day retention window)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P2 features working correctly: (1) GET /api/settings/retention returns current retention_days (default 30), (2) PUT /api/settings/retention updates setting with validation (1-365 range), (3) Dashboard stats cache with 60s TTL, invalidated on retention change, (4) Dashboard stats and intelligence feed both apply retention window filter, (5) Settings page at /settings with retention dropdown (7/14/30/60/90/180/365 days), save button, and Pipeline Status card. Data is mostly from March 28, so with 30d retention ~472 items show, with 7d retention fewer items show. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_retention_and_cache_v11.py.
